text: Every class A-E trades at $20 risk from forward bar 1. The hard-coded $60 is a defect. kellyRiskUsd stays $20 until a class is promoted. The forward gate is mean net R > 0, L80 > 0, and Holm over the 5 streams. After promotion, risk is min(0.75%, half-Kelly) on forward realized net R only. P5 data never sizes a forward trade. Recompute at each weekly review (Monday 00:00 UTC cutoff) and hold until the next review. Drop back to $20 if the forward bound goes <= 0. Sizing may go under $20 below the cap.
